reviews.text:
Worst Experience Ever – Extremely Rude and Unprofessional Behaviour!
We had a terrible experience because of the unacceptable behaviour of the so-called manager, waiter, or server. While we were still having our dinner, he intentionally switched off the lights and fans and demanded that we leave immediately. Initially, we thought there was a power cut and continued eating in the dark. Later, when we realised what had actually happened, we requested him to switch the lights back on.
He reluctantly agreed to give us just 15 minutes and even set an alarm, as though we were being timed and forced out! To make matters worse, when we were leaving, he started arguing and fighting with us, showing absolutely no respect or basic courtesy, even though there were women in our group.
Is this how you treat your customers? Is this the kind of hospitality and professionalism you offer?
If your staff cannot even behave respectfully towards customers, how can families feel comfortable bringing women and young girls to your establishment? Such aggressive and disrespectful behaviour raises serious concerns about the safety and comfort of your guests.
We came to enjoy a peaceful dinner, not to be humiliated, forced to eat in the dark, or subjected to unnecessary arguments.
Absolutely disgusting customer service and completely unacceptable behaviour! The management should take this incident seriously and ensure that no other customer has to go through such an experience.
I would strongly advise families, especially those visiting with women and children, to think twice before choosing this place.

owner_response.text:
Hi Thanvi,

We’re genuinely disappointed to read this, and we’re truly sorry that your experience with us was anything but the warm and respectful hospitality we aim to provide. There is no excuse for making a guest feel rushed, uncomfortable, or unwelcome, and we take your feedback very seriously.

We will be addressing this with our team and making sure our guests are treated with the courtesy and respect they deserve.

We would sincerely love the opportunity to welcome you back and serve you the experience you should have had in the first place — preferably **with all the lights on this time!** 😅 We hope you’ll give us a chance to make it right, and perhaps serve you better in daylight rather than have you leave in the dark. ❤️

reviews.author: Sharuk Shaik
reviews.text:

His behavior came across as rude, unprofessional, and unnecessarily disrespectful. It felt as though he intentionally made the situation difficult for us instead of handling it professionally. This was extremely poor service and completely ruined our experience. Very disappointing.

Anybody who comes to a place and spends money has also worked hard to earn that money. When a waiter spends three hours genuinely taking care of you—bringing dishes, refilling water, getting drinks, checking on you, and making sure everything is comfortable—I completely understand tipping them, and I’m happy to do so.

But what I fail to understand is when someone in formals and a tie comes over twice in three hours to take an order, stands in front of you for five minutes, and then seems to expect a tip.

What exactly have you done to earn that tip? 🤷‍♂️

A tip should be a gesture of appreciation for genuine service and effort, not an automatic entitlement simply because you showed up at the table.

owner_response.text:
We are sorry to hear about your experience and understand your concern regarding the missing cash. The safety and trust of our guests are extremely important to us.

We would like to clarify that the valet parking service is operated by an independent third-party agency.
However, we take all customer concerns seriously and do not dismiss any complaint related to services provided on our premises.

* As soon as the matter was brought to our attention, we cooperated with you and informed the Local jurisdiction Police station as well as valet agency so that a proper investigation could be conducted. 
* You were very confused and misinterpreted twice by saying the lost money was Rs.8,000 and then again you changed it by saying Rs. 15,500.
* But still we valued your time and money and contacted the police to arrive at our restaurant.
* They did arrive but you were not ready to explain and co-operate with the police officer. You just left suddenly in car without proper intimation or anything.

So this is where the doubt arises as well as confusion builds up.

Making Allegations is simple, but one has to STAND FOR the words spoken.


We value all our guests and are committed to maintaining a safe and pleasant experience for everyone.
